title: UGC craft
description: The edit language of a short-form UGC ad, with one number for each move: the cadence table and the three-second rule, the breath trim and J/L cuts, the three named zoom moves (jump zoom, punch-in, focus push) and the one creep for stills, the canonical caption spec (grouping, size, stroke, position, timing, platform variants), the sound map with levels, music beds and trend audio, and the texture pass. Load it when cutting and dressing a UGC ad, or when one drags, feels flat or looks AI-made.
summary: UGC edit language with one number per move: cadence, jump zoom, punch-in, focus push, the caption spec, cue levels and music.

requires.why: Cuts, taps and the result each get one cue at a stated level.
A licensed or generated bed that sits at 0.12 under the voice.
Trimming VO air and measuring the export's loudness.
Shot length, caption position and zoom targets are judged on frames.

models.note: Tap, click, soft pop, one confirmation tone.
Instrumental bed at a whole-frame tempo (100 or 120 BPM at 30 fps).
